title: Muscle Tissue RNA Extraction
author: Joesph B Lesnak
materials: Try to avoid really blood sections

steps.title: Collect and Weigh Tissue
steps.instruction: Remove tissue, cut off a section, and place in a 1.5 ml tube on dry ice. Measure and record the weight of each tissue sample.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Buffer RLT by adding 10 ul of β-mercaptoethanol (BME) per 1 mL of Buffer RLT.

steps.title: Pulverize Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize the tissue samples using liquid nitrogen and a Corvaris TT1 system.

substeps.instruction: Place tissue pieces in a Corvaris TT1 bag and keep on dry ice until ready.
Dip the bag into liquid nitrogen and impact with Corvaris until a powder is formed.

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Digestion
steps.instruction: Lysis the pulverized tissue and digest proteins using Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 uL of Buffer RLT + BME lysis buffer to the bag to retrieve frozen samples and transfer to a 1.5 mL tube.
Mix up and down with a pipette tip to ensure all powdered sample is recovered from the bag.
Add 590 uL of DNA/RNAse free water to each sample.
Add 10 uL of proteinase K to each sample.
Mix by hand (turning over) and incubate in a heat block at 55°C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant from the debris.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 10,000g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Add 0.5 volume of 100% ETOH (~450 ul) to each sample.
Mix by hand; do not vortex.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto an RNeasy spin column to bind RNA.

substeps.instruction: Load 700 uL of sample onto the RNeasy spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000g at room temperature.
Repeat loading until the entire sample has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash Column
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA using Buffer RW1.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 uL Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000g at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform DNAse Clean-up
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNAse by adding 70 uL of Buffer RDD (from fridge) to 10 uL of Qiagen DNAse (from -20°C).
Add the total volume (~80 uL) directly onto the column.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add 350 uL Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000g at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Buffer RPE and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 uL Buffer RPE onto the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000g at room temperature.
Pipette another 500 uL Buffer RPE onto the column and centrifuge for 2 minutes at >8,000g at room temperature.
Transfer the RNeasy spin column to a new 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge the column for 1 minute at full speed (16,000g) at room temperature to dry.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the RNeasy column to a new 1.5 mL collection tube.
Pipette 40 uL of RNase-free water and incubate for 1 minute.
Centrifuge the column for 15 seconds at >8,000g at room temperature.

steps.title: Quantify and Store
steps.instruction: Analyze the RNA quality and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Measure concentration and A260/A280 and A260/A230 ratios using a NanoDrop.
Store RNA at -80°C.
